latest_action.text: Considered by Senate (Message from the House considered). (consideration: CR S1647)

card.summary: The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (or the SAVE America Act) requires individuals to provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections. It also requires voters to present valid photo identification when casting ballots in federal elections, either in person or alongside mail-in ballots. States must check their voter rolls against federal databases to remove noncitizens and establish processes for alternative proof or handling name discrepancies.

card.label: H.R. 22
card.summary: The SAVE Act amends the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 to require individuals to provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when applying to register to vote in federal elections. It mandates that states establish ongoing programs to ensure only citizens are registered, remove noncitizens from voter rolls, and create alternative pathways and uniform affidavits for applicants who cannot immediately present standard citizenship documents.

summary: H.R. 8595 provides fiscal year 2027 appropriations for national security, the Department of State, and related foreign affairs and international programs. Additionally, Division B of the bill contains the 'Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act' (SAVE America Act), which imposes new federal requirements for voter registration and voting in federal elections.

affected_groups.effect: Receive annual funding, administrative direction, and operational restrictions for foreign programs, security, and diplomatic missions.
affected_groups.group: Department of State and federal foreign assistance agencies

affected_groups.effect: Must provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register and present valid photo identification to vote.
affected_groups.group: Voters and voter registration applicants in federal elections

affected_groups.effect: Must enforce new citizenship verification rules, update voter rolls using the SAVE system, and collect photo identification or process provisional ballots.

key_provisions: Provides appropriations for the Department of State, international organizations, international commissions, and related programs such as the Peace Corps, Millennium Challenge Corporation, and Export-Import Bank.
Funds bilateral economic and security assistance, including global health programs, international disaster assistance, and foreign military financing.
Establishes the America First Opportunity Fund and allocates funding for initiatives countering foreign influence and synthetic drug trafficking.
Requires individuals registering to vote in federal elections to provide documentary proof of United States citizenship.
Requires voters to present valid photo identification when casting ballots in person or submit copies/affidavits when voting other than in person in federal elections.
Mandates that states compare their official voter registration lists with the Department of Homeland Security's SAVE system to remove noncitizens.

summary_detail.significance: The legislation shapes U.S. foreign policy, national security spending, and international aid priorities for fiscal year 2027 while enacting major federal voting and registration mandates across all states.
